rules.message: Requested period is missing or incomplete.
rules.suggested_resolution: Request clarification from the requesting agency.

rules.message: Requested period is invalid (missing bound or start after end).
rules.suggested_resolution: Request a corrected date range from the requesting agency.

rules.message: No usable subject identifier was extracted from the request.
rules.suggested_resolution: Request account, device, or customer identifiers from the requesting agency.

rules.message: Request spans an overbroad set of product/data domains.
rules.suggested_resolution: Route to SME review for scope assessment and possible narrowing request.

rules.message: Legal process type is ambiguous or could not be determined.
rules.suggested_resolution: Route to SME review to confirm the legal process type.

rules.message: The source request still contains unfilled LERS template placeholder text.
rules.suggested_resolution: Return to the requesting agency for a completed template or correct the field with a human override when independently verified.

rules.message: One or more requested data categories lacks an obvious matching cited authority.
rules.suggested_resolution: Confirm the scope-to-authority matrix before final approval or request narrowing/clarification.
